detail.longDescription: Picking a project management app is like wandering through the story of Goldilocks—there are so many options and no perfect fit. It feels like you'll always be sampling scalding porridge and trying to get comfy in a doll-sized bed. Asana is a quality option (so much so that it's made Zapier's list of the best free, small business, and enterprise project management apps), but that doesn't mean it's guaranteed to work for you.
